scope: LOCAL_ONLY video review preview, synchronized comparison, selection history and timecode annotation

implementation.thumbnail_frames: thumbnail frame first/middle/last (poster alias) now resolves distinct local video frames and isolates cache entries by normalized frame
implementation.preview: Range-backed browser video preview keeps loop, mute, playback-rate and short-step controls; reviewer adds probe-fps frame stepping
implementation.sync_compare: review inbox supports explicit 2-4 candidate synchronization with shared play/pause and short-step controls
implementation.selection: proxy winner selection remains separate from approval and preserves selection history
implementation.annotations: timecode markers support structured category/comment, optional derived screenshot MediaVersion, same-project rework Job, current-player-time capture and marker seek

required: Windows x64 three viewport review UAT

notes: Automated tests use local fixture media only; formal production UAT remains outstanding.
